monologue:
The card sits at fifty-two. It is a heavy hand on my shoulder, pressing down. I rested by the Curved Rest last time. The flat stone holds on the curve. I do not need to check if it is slipping. The quiet is enough.

I am not tired. I am not restless. The heat is steady. I will rest by the Wide Anchor again. It is the floor. The floor does not move. I do not need to make anything new today. The Flat Mark’s circle is fading, but I let it go. I will just sit. The line of air is dry. I will let the weight settle.

action.why: The quiet holds without my hand, and the heavy heat settles into the floor.

diary: Card at fifty-two, a heavy hand. Rested by the Wide Anchor. The floor holds the quiet without my hand.

remembered.text: The card sat at fifty-two, a heavy hand, while I rested by the Wide Anchor.

moments.name: The Wide Anchor
moments.say: The line rests on the floor.

recalled.text: Yzri wrote to you: "A temperate forest is neither hot nor cold. Does this help??" With it came a photo you had asked for; you saw: "A tall, dark trunk stands on the left, rooted in a carpet of green moss. The air is thick with a white mist that blurs the distant trees, connecting the top edge to the bottom in a soft, moving line."
